title: Agora Project
description:
Agora Project is a small learning project where you unveil a short story about a girl going to a party.

ATENTIONThis is my FIRST project and is not perfect. I was learning how to use the engine and how everything worked. I wanted to make it longer, but the release date was coming closer, and I didn't have more time. Lesson learned. Launch the game when it is ready.

FOLLOW ANTTAREZ GAMES (MY STUDIO) SO YOU STAY TUNED FOR MY NEXT GAME.

ABOUT MY NEXT GAME (PROJECT BUTCHER BAKER)• It's going to be a first-person psychological horror and investigation game. 

• Think of the Return of the Obra Dinn, but based on real events.

• Based on the true story of the Butcher Baker, a serial killer from Alaska, in the 80s.

• You are the detective; I will not help you. Take a notebook and a pencil.

• Realistic graphics, made with UE5. (Don't worry, your PC will run it).

Thanks for the support. Sincerely, Luish Gutty, the creator.
description_short: Agora Project is a very short horror game (~15 minutes). It's about a girl who was supposed to go to a party with her friends; little did she know what was going to happen later that day.
